label: D2 after choosing a2 and landing in S1 (a2 rare transition)
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass), and only when the agent chose a2 and the rare transition took it to S1: in_action == a2 and in_state == S1 at D2 (in_action=2 & in_state=1 inputs). Recall and mass recall are ~1.0 on dev (only 14 stray activations, ~0% of mass, on a1->S1 common D2 steps), but precision is ~0.60: about 40% of a2->S1 D2 steps stay under threshold. Being active vs not, and magnitude, depend on context. It is larger and more reliable when the previous trial was unrewarded (prev_reward == 0 subset: precision 0.82, holds 86% of the top activation quartile but only 9% of the bottom one) and when the agent has been repeating a2 (stay == 1), with the biggest values in runs of unrewarded a2->S1 rare trials. It is weak or silent after a rewarded previous trial and when the previous choice was a1. It never fires at D1 or GO, or on any D2 step that reaches S2. Adding prev_reward or stay conditions lowered F1 (0.62 / 0.73), and value < 7.54 gave only a small gain (0.77), so I recorded the simple observed predicate (action is known at D2, so no future variables).
